title: MV My First Game: Dextera Mortis

posts.author: Darkmoon9
posts.body:
Hi, I have been working on this project for about a year now. I am a beginner to RPG Maker and I recently learned how to use the program from video tutorials on youtube. This is my very first project. While I am not very technically proficient, the story I am trying to tout with this game is rather personal to me as it is based on my currently unpublished novel. Yes, I am currently using AI art for the character portraits only, no other part of this game was made with AI assistance, and even these will likely be replaced further down the line, if I can afford it. The game is currently in its very early stages, Almost anything is subject to change if deemed necessary. I appreciate any feedback and I am willing to make chances to the game based on that feedback.
Gameplay
This is a turn based RPG with heavy focus on the story. Nothing too out of the ordinary from the basic settings of RPG Maker, though I am using a few additional plugins. Expect turn based combat, elemental attacks that also inflicts different statuses and debuffs and buffs, elemental weaknesses, that sort of stuff. Though one aspect to mention is that different weapon types usually grant additional skills .
Assets
The assets are mostly from the Steam dlc page or free sources found online. I don´t plan on this game being a Commercial project. But if anyone detect anything but isn't up to snuff out about the assets used, please inform me so I can fix the problem, but it should be mostly fine to use as it is store bought assets from Steam for the most part (Or character sprites made from the built in sprite creator. )
Story and Setting
The year is 2044, humanity has recently made contact with an alien species known as the Aetarians, the Aetarians shared their powerful technology with humanity, including the ability to make androids, facsimiles of intelligent life nearly indistinguishable from a human being. But some thought about the creation of androids were playing God and would anger the Creator. A civil war eventually broke out in the United States between those who embraced the new gifts of the Aetarians and those who thoughts their gifts were heretical and an affront to God Almighty.
Eventually the android abolitionists would be victorious in the Civil War and androids in the United States were exterminated on sight. But many still remained, hiding in the shadows. Taking advantage of the conflict, an abolitionist Genaral named Clark Lewis took control of the United States, declaring himself Emperor The United Empire was born. Soon the Emperor would declare himself the Creator in the flesh and displayed terrifying supernatural powers as proof of his divinity. Little did the people know that Emperor Clark Lewis was in reality Abaddon, a terror from beyond reality. Those who embraced the Emperor as their one true god was marked by their mark, displaying supernatural powers of their own, but becoming unable to disobey an order from the Emperor.
The impact of the mark was felt in the afterlife as the souls of the marked would go to neither Heaven nor Hell, greately alarming the rulers of both realms. Especially as the reach of the United Empire would spread across the globe. This is a story of those who still resisted Abaddon's influence, whenever their allegiance belonged to Heaven, Hell, or neither.
Main Characters
Lilian Corvus
A collage student living in United Empire occupied London. A chess prodigy, hacker and tactician, she has long used her skills to the benefit of the Resistance. But bow she is called to accomplish her most dangerous mission yet.
Edmund Wolf
A law student from a family of lawyers and a childhood friend of Lilian. Edmund's father was put to death by the United Empire for defending Resistance members in court, leaving Edmund hungry for revenge and eager to make the Empire pay, even if it costs him his life.
Nicola
A jewish orphan raised in a monastery in Italy. She developed the miraculous power to heal any illness at an early age. People travel far and wide to see Nicola to heal their ills. These miracles caught the attention of the Pope, who plans to travel
to see Nicola so.she can be canonised as a Saint after death. But Nicola herself yearns to discover more about her jewish heritage.
Damien Velikov
Brought up among the Solomonari, warlocks following the ways of King Solomon, binding both celestial and demonic spirits. Damien was brought up learning the natural magic that is witchcraft, but he always felt drawn to the forbidden arts of diabolism.
Saiki Sango
The ghost of a Japanese idol murdered by an obsessive fan. Having displayed psychic powers even in life, these powers grew in strength after her death. Her path crossed with Lilian after a fateful game of riddles, after which they became friends.
Gabriel Lucin
A devout young man and heir to his fathers legacy within the secret society of the Flame of Light. He is expected to follow in his fathers footsteps in following their deity in enforcing cosmic orders.
Please help with the upload
Also, how on earth do I upload my prototype build to the site? I tried deploying the file, it works fine by this point, but when I upload it to google drive and then download it the game refuses to start. Help would be appreciated. The screen displays "failed to display js/plugins/community_basic" "failed to display js/plugins/YEP_MessageCore.js"Seems to be a different plugin that fails each time. The game works fine in RPG Maker and when deployed, it only goes wrong after I upload it and then redownload it. I will be happy to share my results so far if I manage to get it to work.
Edit: Disclaimer:
a game of this nature obviously involves religious elements, I would even say the game is straight up about the nature of spirituality. There are political elements as well, but mostly related to the fictional time period the game is set rather than a direct paralel of real life. Though some references are to be expected as this game takes place in a fictional future version of the real world, just with added elements such as angels, demons, androids, aliens and vampires.

If the link doesn't work for any reason please tell me. But it seems to  be publicly accessible. Any feedback would be appreciated. But keep in mind this is a very early build and there are a lot of known issues I haven't yet got around to fixing, but they are mostly minor.
Known Issues
1: There is a problem with some of the doors opening earlier than they are supposed to in the collage dorm section. I have no idea how to fix that problem, help would be appreciated.
2: There is a corpse that moves in the post massacre section of the monastery in the chapel. It is not supposed to do that. I do know how to fix it however, but have not yet gotten around to it.
3: There is no way to progress beyond the Italian Forest section with Nicola, that is has far as I haven't made it currently. That section in general is quite unfinished and some things may not work as they should as of yet. But things should be relatively fine until after the monastery section.
Also, I have no clue what the age rating of this game would be. It doesn't really contain any nudity or much sexual elements. It does however contain violent elements and quite a lot of blood in one section in particular. Hopefully this falls under PG 13 according to the rules, But I am really bad at gauging that. So in the event of this game qualifying as 18+. I would like a moderator to tell me.
Edit: Managed to get dowload file to work.

posts.author: Darkmoon9
posts.body:
Update, I have reworked a lot of the early parts of the game, updated the artwork, including commissioned artwork for Lilian and Nicola to replace the previously AI generated artwork. I have also added battle voices to the game using Replica Studios, I might add more varied voice lines in the future, though the current plugin doesnt allow for it and I have yet to figure out how to get the alternatives to work.
Chapter 2 is now finished, which includes a new dungeon, the Abyssal Temple. I have finished a good part of chapter 3 as well. I am also considering splitting the game into more chapters as the two current chapters are pretty long for a chapter.
I have also changed the title of the game from Dextera Manu Dei to Dextera Mortis. This is because a friend pointed out to me that the to acronym DEI is used frequently in modern political debates and it might be best to change the title of the game to avoid confusion. For those who do not understand latin, Dextera Manu Dei translates to "The Right Hand of God", with Dei in particular meaning "of God" in latin. This title was in reference to the character of Nicola. The title Dextera Mortis was the original title of this story before I changed it at some point as means "The Right Hand of Death", which refers to the character of Edmund Wolf and his pact with the Angel of Death, Samael.
I have also updated the titlescreen to something I found on opengamingart.org. Other minor updates includes expanding the options menu, as well as making both the keyboard and controller buttons configurable.

posts.author: Darkmoon9
posts.body:
Game updated and Itch page created:
https://darkmoon6789.itch.io/dextera-mortis
Overhauled the skill system again and created a visible skill tree so the player known what skills lead to others down the line. I also created multiple difficulty options, which are the following:
Pawn (Easy)
Made to be a story mode difficulty, not much challange, primarily for people who just want experience the story.
Rook (Normal)
The previous default difficulty. Some challange, but not super difficult.
Queen (Hard)
A diffuculty for those who seek a challange. I have made sure it is beatable by beating the game on this difficulty. Will probably be difficulty I test the game on from now on, if a challange is beatable on Queen difficulty, it is probably beatable on easier difficulties.
I may create an ever harder difficulty in the future if I find making the game even harder is viable.
I also fixed a few gamebreaking errors on the Empyreal route in chapter 5. The game is now playable on both routes up until the end of chapter 6. Chapter 6 includes storming Lucifers citadel of Pandemonium and braving the horrifying Forest of Suicide, one of the most infamous regions of the Abyss.

Many bugs have been fixed, all 10 chapters are now completed (Including 4 endings) and all ai artwork has been replaced. The game no longer uses ai at all actually. The last couple of artworks for the final few party members will.be included in an update when they are done.
The credits can be found in the game itself, in the main menu. (Please tell me if I forgot to credit someone so the mistake can be rectified.)

https://darkmoon6789.itch.io/dextera-mortis
Story Description:
The game is a dark science fiction fantasy rpg set in an alternate version of our world, one where angels, demons, vampires as well as aliens are a known quantity.
The year is 2044 and a fascist regime known as the United Empire dominate most of the world. Its Emperor claiming to be God and demands to be worshipped as such. Though many suspect the true nature of the Emperor is something altogether darker.
Lilian Corvus as well as her friend Edmund Wolf are members of the resistance against the Empire and gets tasked by their superiors to steal a strange puzzlebox from the collection of Gregor Lucin, a prosecutor who they believe serves the United Empire, but who in reality is a member of a secret society called the Flame of Light that serves the angels of the Empyrean.
The game also follows Nicola, an orphan girl raised in a monastery in Italy, blessed with the power to heal the sick with a touch. Nicola discovers with time that she might be the savior destined to lead humanity in the final conflict with the Emperor.
